scenario: [LUNI.4.5.1] position 4: an `implicit` unit formula auto-applies at a service `call` keyword argument. `timer.set_period` declares `kwarg period: nanosecond`, the call passes `s.freq` (Hz), and the program compiles because `hz_period`'s `hz_to_period` applies there.
rules_ds:
unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency

unit formula hz_period inverting implicit:
    hz_to_period(x: Hz): nanosecond  = 1e9 / x
    period_to_hz(x: nanosecond): Hz  = 1e9 / x

service timer.set_period:
    kwarg period: nanosecond required
    no response

schema Signal scope logical:
    freq: Hz key

rule slow:
    Signal s
->
    call timer.set_period period: s.freq cooldown: 30s
